newsitem.title: USA: Woman Air Force pilot missing in U.S. crash.
newsitem.headline: Woman Air Force pilot missing in U.S. crash.

text.p: The woman pilot of a U.S. Air Force A-10 attack jet was missing on Wednesday after her aircraft crashed at a training range in southwest Arizona on Tuesday night, the Air Force said.
Captain Amy Lynn Svoboda was on a routine training mission in the single-seat fighter carrying six practice bombs that emit smoke and a small flash on contact with the ground for accuracy evaluation.
Air Force officials and safety experts were travelling to the crash site to ensure the safety of the scene before a recovery team could begin to sort through the wreckage.
